scope: Current source verified byte-for-byte against A02 snapshot, frozen plan and existing tests. No tests or server jobs executed in this review; terminal experiment acceptance remains pending.

counting_rule.authority: ledger generation records indexed 1..5 plus their automatic cost/resource closures; not accepted count, provider calls or train-job count

branches.head: accepted selected candidate
branches.note: Both public-dev screens; one selected public-accept and sealed confirmation; exactly one ledger record.

branches.head: unchanged
branches.note: Includes task early rejection after public-accept (sealed explicitly not run), or completed sealed-dependent rejection.

branches.head: unchanged
branches.note: Both screens exist, selector chooses none; no public-accept or sealed job.

branches.head: unchanged
branches.note: No-training status pairs (candidate_failed, not_started), (verified_not_run, candidate_failed), or (candidate_failed, verified_not_run). Lane A failure leaves B not_started; a verified sibling is verified_not_run. Both preparation failures fall into candidate_execution_incomplete instead.

branches.head: unchanged
branches.note: Caught candidate runtime error, post-train task rejection, or typed retryable runner failure recorded as train_incomplete/eval_incomplete. Requires real closed attempt/cost evidence; an open reservation stops host closure. Also covers both preparation failures; outcome follows the frozen status classification, not an inferred scientific rejection.

branches.branch: authoring repair / runner attempt retry / replay
branches.note: Internal retries add no generation. Replaying an already committed execution adds no record; if a valid execution receipt was published before a crash but not yet committed, recovery appends its single original generation record once.
Segment fails and cost evidence is saved; no artificial generation record. Resume remains at same next index.

branches.branch: exception or budget overrun after ledger commit but before automatic closure
branches.generation_delta: already appended record remains; no extra record
branches.note: Not a valid finished round until closure is reconciled. Recovery may complete the last existing closure; report/terminal acceptance stays blocked while incomplete or over budget.
Before generation loop; cannot produce five-round terminal result.

branches.branch: final-confirmation failure after five closed generations
branches.note: Ledger stays at five; no completed report. Resume existing run to finish/reuse final jobs, then run independent audit.

steps: Loop stops at exactly contract.max_generations=5; prevalidate checks budget, generation_index=5 and zero open attempts.
Close segment completed/normal at five; rebuild authoritative ledger/head/lifecycle binding and verify all attempt journals.
Bind two new final-confirmation jobs: Genesis reference versus terminal accepted current_best; if no candidate was accepted, both use the reference checkpoint but remain separate jobs.
Run genesis then final on lane-a using frozen sealed cohort: 7 seeds x 64 episodes each, 14 seed units / 896 episodes total. Reuse only this same terminal job receipt when recovering.
Publish final result without acceptance authority or public feedback; settle final costs, validate resource closure and publish generation_session_report.json.
